questions.question: The process of starting a computer by initiating through hardware such as a button press, or by a software command is called ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Booting**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The action of a computer to load an operating system into the computer's main memory or random-access memory (RAM) is called Booting.
 
• Booting is a startup sequence that starts the operating system of a computer when it is turned on.
 
• A boot sequence is the initial set of operations that the computer performs when it is switched on.
 
 
• Every computer has a boot sequence. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

There are two types of Booting:-

__
 
• Warm Booting:__

 __
 
• When the system starts from a powered state or not an initial state then it is called warm booting.
 
• Example is the sleep mode in our computer. The computer doesnt turn off power but goes to sleep and when it is woken up, it goes through a warm boot.
 
 
 
• Cold Booting:__
 
 
• The Cold Booting is that in which the system starts from a powerless state or an initial state.
 
• Examples include turning on the computer by applying power or restarting the system.

questions.question:
Considering the below statements, choose the CORRECT option

(i) A software program is a set of instructions given to a computer for the execution of the task

(ii) Software is the variable part of a computer while the hardware is the invariable part

(iii) System software is designed for computer-specific tasks

options.text: Statements (ii) and (iii) are correct, and (i) is false
Statements (i) and (iii) are correct and (ii) is false
Statements (i) and (ii) are correct, and (iii) is false

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Statements (i) and (ii) are correct, and (iii) is false.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement (i):**

 
 
• A software program is a set of instructions written in a programming language that tells the computer how to perform a specific task.
 
• ✅ This statement is correct.
 
 
 
• **Statement (ii):**
 
 
• Software is the variable part of a computer (can be updated, changed, or modified), while hardware is the invariable part (physical and fixed).
 
• ✅ This statement is correct.
 
 
 
• **Statement (iii):**
 
 
• The claim “System software is designed for computer-specific tasks” is **false** and misleading.
 
• System software (like operating systems, device drivers, compilers, utilities) is designed for **general system management tasks** such as managing resources, running applications, and providing services to users.
 
• Application software is actually designed for **user-specific tasks** (e.g., MS Word, Photoshop, games).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **System Software:**

 
 
• Examples: Operating System (Windows, Linux), Compiler, Interpreter, Device Drivers.
 
• Primary role: Manage hardware resources and provide a platform for application software.
 
 
 
• **Application Software:**
 
 
• Examples: MS Office, Browsers, Games.
 
• Primary role: Perform specific tasks required by the user.

questions.question: Which process includes fixing of security holes in the system?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Patching**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Patching** is the process of fixing security vulnerabilities and other bugs by applying updates or "patches" to the software or system.
 
• It is a crucial part of maintaining the security and integrity of any IT system.
 
• By regularly applying patches, organizations can protect themselves from potential exploits and attacks that take advantage of known vulnerabilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Risk Control:** This involves identifying, assessing, and prioritizing risks followed by coordinated application of resources to minimize, control, and monitor the probability or impact of unfortunate events. It does not specifically involve fixing security holes.
 
• **Data Encryption:** This is a method of converting data into a code to prevent unauthorized access. While important for data security, it does not fix security holes in the system.
 
• **Risk Likelihood:** This refers to the probability of a risk occurring. It is a part of risk assessment but does not involve fixing security holes.
